settings.rules_assignment_subtitle: Choose which strategic lenses apply to each task type

settings.rules_fw_ref_subtitle: Learn about each strategic evaluation framework
settings.rules_fw_ref_rice_desc: Reach × Impact × Confidence ÷ Effort. Prioritization framework from Intercom for scoring tasks by audience reach, impact, confidence, and effort.
settings.rules_fw_ref_drice_desc: Extended RICE that factors in dependency weight — how many other tasks are blocked by this one.
settings.rules_fw_ref_ddd_desc: Domain-Driven Design. Evaluates tasks through bounded context alignment, ubiquitous language, and strategic/tactical pattern fit.
settings.rules_fw_ref_heart_desc: Happiness, Engagement, Adoption, Retention, Task success. Google's UX metrics framework for holistic UX impact scoring.
settings.rules_fw_ref_kcs_desc: Knowledge-Centered Service. Evaluates documentation tasks: is knowledge captured at creation, reusable, and continuously improved?
settings.rules_fw_ref_wsjf_desc: Weighted Shortest Job First. Calculates Cost of Delay ÷ Job Duration to sequence work for maximum economic benefit.
settings.rules_fw_ref_moscow_desc: Must / Should / Could / Won't prioritization. Classifies requirements into four categories for scope and stakeholder management.
settings.rules_fw_ref_ice_desc: Impact × Confidence × Ease. Lightweight scoring system for rapid experiment prioritization, each dimension scored 1-10.

settings.danger_archive_subtitle: Remove completed tasks you no longer need
settings.danger_archive_callout_desc: Complete = work is done, task stays visible. Archived = complete task hidden from daily views. This control permanently deletes both, based on when they were last updated. Active and in-progress tasks are never touched.

settings.app_readiness_callout_desc: Install from a standalone browser tab when you want the full PWA prompt. Use Companion and x-callback links when you need to reopen the same section inside the Home Assistant app, Siri Shortcuts, or automations.
settings.pwa_about_p1: Meitheal (IPA: /ˈmɛhəl/) — from Irish: a cooperative work party where neighbours come together to help with farming, harvesting, or building. The tradition reflects a core principle: work shared is work halved.
settings.pwa_about_p2: A Home Assistant-native, Astro-first task and life management engine — built for people who think in systems.

settings.pwa_uninstall_how:
How to uninstall:
Chrome/Edge: Open the installed app → ⋮ menu → "Uninstall Meitheal"
Safari: Long-press the icon on your home screen → Remove
Firefox: Not applicable (does not support PWA install)

settings.grocy_desc: Connect to Grocy for household inventory and chore management. Meitheal can import Grocy tasks and expose its own tasks back.
settings.n8n_desc: Trigger automation workflows when tasks are created, updated, or completed. Create complex pipelines that react to task events.
settings.webhook_desc: Generic outgoing webhooks for any service. Each event sends a JSON payload with the full task object and event type.
settings.webhook_secret_hint: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign webhook payloads. Verify with the X-Webhook-Signature header.

en.settings.grocy_detected_desc: Grocy addon found — URL auto-populated from HA ingress. No additional setup needed.
en.settings.grocy_url_help: The URL of your Grocy instance. If running Grocy as a Home Assistant add-on, it's typically available at http://homeassistant.local:9192 or via the HA ingress proxy.
en.settings.grocy_key_help: Generate a Grocy API key in Grocy → Settings → API Keys → Add. This key allows Meitheal to read and write chores and tasks.
en.settings.grocy_auto_key_title: Attempt to auto-generate a Grocy API key
en.settings.grocy_sync_help: Controls how data flows between Grocy and Meitheal. Import pulls chores/tasks into Meitheal, Export pushes completions to Grocy, Bidirectional keeps both in sync.
en.settings.grocy_interval_help: How often Meitheal polls Grocy for changes. More frequent = faster sync but more API calls.
en.settings.grocy_open_title: Open Grocy in a new tab
en.settings.n8n_auto_desc: Events are sent/received automatically via WebSocket — no additional webhook configuration needed.
en.settings.n8n_mode_desc: Choose how Meitheal communicates with your automation engine.
en.settings.n8n_ws_desc: Node-RED and n8n addons communicate with Meitheal automatically through the HA WebSocket. Select which events to broadcast below.
en.settings.n8n_nr_detected_desc: Node-RED addon found and connected automatically.
en.settings.n8n_ev_created_title: Fires when a new task is created
en.settings.n8n_ev_updated_title: Fires when task fields are modified
en.settings.n8n_ev_completed_title: Fires when a task is marked done
en.settings.n8n_ev_deleted_title: Fires when a task is permanently removed
en.settings.n8n_ev_overdue_title: Fires when a task passes its due date
en.settings.n8n_flows_desc: Deploy pre-built automation flows for all Meitheal events directly to Node-RED.
en.settings.n8n_webhook_help: The webhook URL from your n8n or Node-RED flow. Meitheal will POST a JSON payload to this URL whenever selected task events occur.
en.settings.n8n_api_key_help: If your n8n/Node-RED instance requires authentication, enter the API key here. This is used in the Authorization header for webhook requests.
en.settings.n8n_secret_help: HMAC-SHA256 secret for signing webhook payloads. Verify the X-Meitheal-Signature header on your receiving end.
en.settings.n8n_workflow_empty: Configure and save URL/API Key to discover workflows.
en.settings.webhooks_vs_ai_desc: Webhooks send task events to external services and automations (e.g., Zapier, IFTTT, custom APIs). For AI agent protocols like A2A, MCP, and WebMCP, see the AI & Agent Access tab.
en.settings.webhooks_endpoint_help: The URL where Meitheal will POST task event payloads as JSON. Events are sent for task creation, updates, completion, and deletion. Ensure the endpoint accepts POST requests with Content-Type: application/json.
en.settings.webhooks_secret_help: An HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign webhook payloads. When set, Meitheal adds an X-Meitheal-Signature header to each request. Verify this header on your receiving end to ensure payloads are authentic and untampered.
en.settings.todo_desc: Bridge HA todo lists with Meitheal
en.settings.todo_bridge_desc: Bridges Home Assistant's built-in todo lists with Meitheal. Enable this so your HA dashboards and automations that use todo.* entities stay in sync with tasks managed here.
en.settings.todo_toggle_desc: Toggle each todo list on or off. Only enabled lists sync tasks with Meitheal.
en.settings.todo_no_entities: No todo lists detected. Make sure Home Assistant has todo entities (e.g. Shopping List).
en.settings.todo_entity_help: Manually enter a todo entity ID if it's not showing in the auto-detected list above.
en.settings.todo_enable_sync_help: When enabled, Meitheal syncs tasks with your HA todo lists in real-time via WebSocket. Disabled by default to save power — enable only for lists you actively use.
en.settings.todo_sync_off: Off — sync disabled to save power
en.settings.todo_sync_dir_help: Bidirectional keeps both Meitheal and HA in sync — changes in either place propagate. Inbound-only imports from HA without pushing back, which saves power and avoids write conflicts.
en.settings.cal_auto_sync_desc: Running as an HA addon — Meitheal automatically detects your calendar entities and syncs events bidirectionally (past 7 days → next 30 days).
en.settings.cal_toggle_desc: Toggle each calendar on or off. Only enabled calendars sync events with Meitheal.
en.settings.cal_no_entities: No calendars detected. Make sure your Home Assistant integration is connected and has calendar entities.
en.settings.cal_entity_id_help: Manually enter a calendar entity ID if it's not showing in the auto-detected list above. This is rarely needed.
en.settings.caldav_desc: For Nextcloud, Radicale, Baikal — not needed for HA calendars
en.settings.caldav_url_help: URL for your CalDAV server. Meitheal will discover calendars automatically.
en.settings.caldav_configured_desc: Ready to sync alongside Home Assistant calendars.
en.settings.cal_sync_direction_hint: Default for new calendars. Override per calendar using the direction selector on each card.
en.settings.cal_write_back_label: Write back — sync completed tasks to calendar
en.settings.cal_write_back_hint: When enabled, task completions update the corresponding calendar event. Only applies to Export and Bidirectional modes.
en.settings.cal_sync_interval_hint: How often Meitheal auto-syncs events from enabled calendars. "Manual only" syncs only when you click Sync Now.
en.settings.integrations_subtitle: Connect Meitheal to your digital ecosystem.
en.settings.integrations_recommended_desc: Connect Home Assistant first so Meitheal can discover entities and choose the right defaults automatically. Then enable calendars or todo lists, and finish with outgoing automations like n8n or webhooks.
en.settings.ha_advanced_desc: Only needed if running outside Home Assistant
en.settings.ha_token_desc: Generate in HA → Profile → Long-Lived Access Tokens
